disclaimer: Carbon footprint values are estimates. Actual emissions depend on regional emission factors, data quality, and accounting methodology.

electricity.description: Grid electricity emission factor (regional grid average)
electricity.source: US EPA eGRID (2024 Summary Tables, Subregion Average)

transportation.description: Average passenger gasoline/diesel car commuting factor
transportation.source: UK DEFRA / EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program (GHGRP)

transportation_bus.description: Diesel fuel consumed by campus shuttles & transit buses
transportation_bus.source: GHG Protocol Emission Factors from Cross-Sector Tools (Diesel Fuel)

waste_organic.description: Organic & food waste sent to municipal landfill (methane generation potential)
waste_organic.source: US EPA Waste Reduction Model (WARM v15 - Food Waste)

waste_plastic.description: Mixed plastics production and end-of-life disposal impact
waste_plastic.source: US EPA WARM v15 (Mixed Plastics Lifecycle)

waste_paper.description: Office paper and cardboard disposal / landfill decomposition
waste_paper.source: US EPA WARM v15 (Mixed Paper / Cardboard)
